question: Do the locally consequential P0554 changes survive ordinary lens-geometry refits, and can a sharper high-acceleration screen retain the raw-lens response of alpha-low while restoring Solar safety?

rules: extent_leak=+0.05 was the only small scalar change that kept Solar safety, produced all 18 fixed-geometry held-out roots, and moved RX J2129 and the four-cluster raw aggregate in the same favorable direction
alpha=0.675 produced all 18 fixed-geometry roots but failed Mercury at -3.510 mas/century
screen_exponent=1.2 strongly suppresses the Solar response and is tested as a compensation rather than a free rescue
apogee_ratio=80 improved RX J2129 and the matched four-cluster raw score with small galaxy and CLASH changes
screen_scale=0.8 moved galaxy, CLASH, and matched four-cluster metrics in the same direction while retaining Solar safety
invariant_power=1.08 improved CLASH and matched four-cluster RMS but lost one RX J2129 root

evaluation.galaxy: 131 SPARC galaxies with fixed nuisances and untouched outer radii
evaluation.derived_cluster: 84 CLASH equivalent acceleration points in 20 systems, no cluster amplitude fit
evaluation.raw: RX J2129 plus four Caminha/CLASH clusters, exact held-out image roots after refitting only ordinary geometry
evaluation.solar: same P0554 analytic Cassini, Earth, Saturn, and Mercury proxies

interpretation_rules.matched_comparison_rule: A candidate-to-parent RMS change is computed only on systems complete for both; recovery of a missing parent root is reported separately.

claim_limits: The variants were generated after inspecting a spent local sensitivity screen and are descriptive interaction tests.
The five raw clusters are spent at project level and no result is a fresh confirmation.
CLASH equivalent accelerations are conventional-GR/NFW-derived targets.
Geometry refits can absorb some radial formula response; this stage tests robustness to that nuisance freedom.
The photon multiplier and nonlocal potential/path response do not yet have a covariant action.
